flavour: Dwarf mail hardens, each suit of armour remembering the hammer blows that forged it.
effect: If this Bound spell is cast with a casting result of 8 or more, the target friendly unit may re-roll any failed Armour Save rolls. If this Bound spell is cast with a casting result of 11 or more, the target friendly unit may re-roll any failed Armour Save rolls and improves its armour value by 1 (to a maximum of 2+). This spell lasts until your next Start of Turn sub-phase.

flavour: Dawi hearts fill with a mighty desire to defend their hold, clan and ancestors.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, all friendly Dwarf units within 21” of the Anvil of Doom gain the Immune to Psychology special rule.

flavour: As the runes are struck, time slows around the marching Dwarf throng.
effect: If the target friendly unit is not fleeing and has already moved during this Movement phase, it may immediately move again.

flavour: The very earth cracks beneath the feet of the enemy, venting forth fire and sulphur.
effect: The target enemy unit suffers 2D6 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -2.
